name: av_cash_flow
description:
Cash flow statements (operating cash flow, capital expenditures, investing, financing, dividend payout and other line items) for one company from Alpha Vantage (CASH_FLOW).
Returns: {symbol, annualReports: [...], quarterlyReports: [...]}, each report with fiscalDateEnding, reportedCurrency and the line items as strings.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker). Annual and quarterly reports both come back; there is no period filter.
Related: av_income_statement, av_balance_sheet; other sources: yf_cash_flow, openbb_cash_flow.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM"}
